description: This PHP script upgrades custom fields in the DynamicFields module for SuiteCRM. It loads certain modules, inspects their custom tables, compares current columns with field definitions, and adds, modifies, or drops columns as necessary to synchronize custom fields with their definitions. It supports simulation mode to preview changes without applying them.

classes.name: DynamicFields
classes.description: A class managing dynamic custom fields, notably with a static method deleteCache.

methods.name: deleteCache
methods.description: Deletes cached data related to DynamicFields to ensure synchronization.
